Investigation focus: Investigate why a deliberately invalid input was rejected and whether the reason matters. We compare a suspected failure with a useful control case, identify the state needed to reproduce it and examine what the resulting artifacts actually support.

Attendees leave with a way to frame the security question, preserve the important evidence and describe the limits of a finding. Longer workshop slots include time to inspect the test design and challenge alternative explanations. NonStop Con, its speakers and these scenarios are fictional sample content; no real vulnerability discovery is claimed.

Finn Berg investigate container management security using synthetic artifacts from a controlled security lab. The session follows the evidence across the relevant components and separates observations from assumptions.
